reference_strategy: 01-home establishes the visual system. Subsequent screens use that image as a style/layout reference; each screen replaces the main content.

screens.title: Start with a goal
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop product interface for Autobots, a personal agent workbench running locally on a Mac. A believable shippable app screen, not a poster or abstract illustration. Landscape 16:10 composition, approximately 1600 by 1000 pixels. Straight-on flat UI, fully visible and uncropped, no laptop or physical device frame. Consistent design system: warm off-white canvas (#F5F4F0), white working surfaces, dark charcoal text, muted forest-green primary actions (#245B4A), fine warm-gray dividers, restrained amber attention states. SF Pro / Inter-like typography, generous spacing, 10px corners, small line icons, impeccable alignment. Quiet premium Mac productivity software. Avoid neon, glassmorphism, purple gradients, robots, decorative 3D and tiny illegible text. Narrow 210px left sidebar with simple abstract two-square mark and wordmark "Autobots"; navigation "Home", "Runs", "Experts", "Workflows", "Approvals", "Files"; "Settings" near bottom; subtle bottom status "This Mac". Content uses clear hierarchy, limited short readable text, natural empty space. Top-right small outline tag "UI concept · Sample data" on every screen. Product is locally hosted but inference uses OpenRouter; never imply offline AI. No terminal/code panels, GPU controls or private chain-of-thought. Do not introduce third inference models or unsupported external messaging integrations.
Screen: Home and new-goal composer. Home is selected in sidebar. Main greeting "What would you like to accomplish?" and subtitle "Give your agents a goal. Stay in control of the work." Central large composer contains "Compare three project management tools for our team and create a one-page brief with sources." Below it are small input chips "Official sources", "One-page brief", "Save locally". A compact model selector reads "DeepSeek Flash" with secondary "via OpenRouter"; adjacent link "View all 14 roles". Budget control "$1.00 run limit". Primary dark-green button "Start run" with arrow. Below the button short disclosure: "Selected task context is sent to OpenRouter." Small calm status row "Files and history are stored on this Mac." Lower part shows three tasteful expert cards "Researcher", "Writer", "Reviewer", each with one-line purpose and tiny line icon, then a short recent-work list with "Weekly research brief" marked "Completed" and "Workspace comparison" marked "Draft". Use readable large text, no dense metrics, no fake model thinking.

revisions.prompt: Edit this existing Autobots UI concept. Preserve all layout, content, colors, typography, sidebar, cards, plan, model label, activity and controls. revisions.purpose: Replace invented AI-vendor comparison content with neutral Option A/B/C sample text.
revisions.prompt: Edit only the body text inside the two document-diff panels of this screenshot. Preserve the entire layout, sidebar, headers, buttons, file path, typography, colors and all other text. Remove all mentions of DeepSeek, OpenRouter Studio, OpenRouter and Local Agent from the comparison document. This is a comparison of unnamed project-management products, not AI models. CURRENT VERSION text exactly: heading Summary; paragraph Initial comparison draft for our team.; heading Comparison; bullets Option A: Team workflow reviewed; Option B: Source notes pending; Option C: Review needed; heading Source notes; sentence Three references attached. PROPOSED VERSION text exactly: heading Summary; paragraph Updated comparison draft for our team.; heading Comparison; bullets Option A: Team workflow reviewed; Option B: Source notes added; Option C: Review complete; heading Source notes; sentence Eight references attached. Highlight changed sentences in muted red on the left and pale green on the right. Do not invent any additional product names or factual claims.

Edit this existing Autobots local-file replacement approval UI. Keep all layout, sidebar, status, target file, action summary, buttons, colors, labels and document wording. Make ONLY these small diff/text refinements: in Current version highlight the full line 'Option C: Review needed.' in the same pale red removed-line style as Option B. In Proposed version highlight 'Option C: Review complete.' in the same pale green added-line style as Option B. The unchanged Option A lines stay unhighlighted. Remove stray quote or semicolon punctuation at the end of Option A and Option B lines, using a normal final period instead. Keep all remaining content exactly unchanged, including illustrative approval label and UI concept / Sample data label.
